why: issue 2020 / RFC-0108 "As built in P10" -- the one rule for which pass ticks a component: on a level image a band pass ticks only its level's components and the executor's own pass the boot level's; otherwise the executor's own pass ticks every component. Shared by the executor's enrolled ticks and the `nros` runtime's `run_ticks_for`. No rclcpp/rclrs counterpart -- neither has preemption levels on one executor. See `rust:Executor::set_registering_level`.
